resources.string: I am honest, trustworthy, and articulate.
I am courageous and stand up for myself.
I choose to be fully present in all that I do.
I am at peace with all that has happened, is happening, and will happen.
My life is a gift and I appreciate everything I have.
I surround myself with positive and supportive people.
I am worthy of love, happiness, and fulfillment.
I believe in my abilities to express my true self with ease.
I am strong, competent, and fully capable of achieving my goals.
I am grateful for all the wonderful opportunities in my life.
Unit 3 Pathway 2: Build a Scrollable List
In this pathway, you learn how to display scrollable lists and grid layouts using Jetpack Compose (LazyColumn & LazyVerticalGrid) and how to configure adaptive app launcher icons.
